sv.title: Anders Jensen: Övertygad att vi hamnar på börsen
sv.summary: CPP Investments och Ontario Teachers blir delägare i Cary Group tillsammans med Nordic Capital. Samtidigt köps CVC ut.

en.title: Anders Jensen: Convinced we will end up on the stock exchange
en.summary: CPP Investments and Ontario Teachers become co-owners of Cary Group together with Nordic Capital. At the same time, CVC is bought out.
